say.en: A sponge, a jellyfish, an earthworm and you: what questions could you ask about each body to sort them quickly? In this lesson: Describe levels of organisation and body symmetry.
Distinguish diploblastic and triploblastic animals.
Classify animals by coelom, segmentation and notochord.

body.en: Sponges show the cellular level of *organisation*, coelenterates the tissue level, flatworms the organ level, and annelids, arthropods, molluscs, echinoderms and chordates the organ-system level. Sponges are mostly asymmetrical; coelenterates, ctenophores and adult echinoderms are radially symmetrical; annelids, arthropods and most others are bilaterally symmetrical. A digestive tract with a single opening is incomplete; one with both mouth and anus is complete. Circulation is open in arthropods and molluscs and closed in annelids and chordates.
body.kn: ಸ್ಪಂಜುಗಳು ಕೋಶ ಮಟ್ಟ, ಸೀಲೆಂಟರೇಟ್‌ಗಳು ಅಂಗಾಂಶ ಮಟ್ಟ, ಚಪ್ಪಟೆಹುಳುಗಳು ಅಂಗ ಮಟ್ಟ, ಉಳಿದವು ಅಂಗವ್ಯೂಹ ಮಟ್ಟ. ಸಮಮಿತಿ: ಅಸಮಮಿತಿ, ತ್ರಿಜ್ಯ ಸಮಮಿತಿ, ದ್ವಿಪಾರ್ಶ್ವ ಸಮಮಿತಿ.

narration.en: Pick the symmetry, the germ layers and the body cavity. Radial symmetry lets any plane through the central axis cut the body into equal halves; bilateral, only one. Diploblastic animals have a non-cellular mesoglea between ectoderm and endoderm; triploblastic animals have mesoderm, which may fill the body (acoelomate), line only the body wall (pseudocoelomate) or line both wall and gut (coelomate).
narration.kn: ಸಮಮಿತಿ, ಭ್ರೂಣ ಪದರಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ದೇಹಕುಹರ ಆಯ್ಕೆಮಾಡಿ. ತ್ರಿಜ್ಯ ಸಮಮಿತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಅಕ್ಷದ ಮೂಲಕ ಯಾವ ಸಮತಲವೂ ದೇಹವನ್ನು ಸಮ ಅರ್ಧಗಳಾಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ದ್ವಿಪಾರ್ಶ್ವ ಸಮಮಿತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದೇ ಸಮತಲ. ದ್ವಿಸ್ತರಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊರ ಮತ್ತು ಒಳ ಪದರಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಮೀಸೋಗ್ಲಿಯ; ತ್ರಿಸ್ತರಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮಧ್ಯಪದರ ದೇಹವನ್ನು ತುಂಬಬಹುದು (ಅದೇಹಕುಹರಿ), ದೇಹಭಿತ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ಆವರಿಸಬಹುದು (ಮಿಥ್ಯಾದೇಹಕುಹರಿ) ಅಥವಾ ಭಿತ್ತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಕರುಳು ಎರಡನ್ನೂ ಆವರಿಸಬಹುದು (ದೇಹಕುಹರಿ).

say.en: Look at cross-sections. In a flatworm, mesoderm fills the space: no body cavity, acoelomate.
In a roundworm the cavity is not fully lined by mesoderm: a pseudocoelom.
In annelids and chordates mesoderm lines both sides of the cavity: a true coelom.
Blue is ectoderm, orange mesoderm, yellow endoderm. Diploblastic animals lack mesoderm.

explanation.en: An asymmetrical body cannot be cut into equal halves by any plane through the centre. A radial body is cut into identical halves by any plane through the central axis. A bilateral body has only one such plane, giving left and right halves. Echinoderm larvae are bilateral, but adults are radial.

say.en: How many ways can you cut each animal into two matching halves? Sort them.

body.en: Diploblastic animals, like coelenterates, have ectoderm and endoderm with an undifferentiated mesoglea between them. Triploblastic animals, from flatworms to chordates, also have a mesoderm. A body cavity lined by mesoderm is a true *coelom* (annelids, molluscs, arthropods, echinoderms, hemichordates, chordates). In aschelminthes the cavity is not lined by mesoderm but by scattered pouches, so it is a pseudocoelom. Flatworms have no body cavity and are acoelomates.
body.kn: ದ್ವಿಸ್ತರಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬಾಹ್ಯಸ್ತರ ಮತ್ತು ಅಂತಃಸ್ತರ; ತ್ರಿಸ್ತರಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮಧ್ಯಸ್ತರವೂ ಇದೆ. ಮಧ್ಯಸ್ತರದಿಂದ ಆವರಿಸಿದ ದೇಹಕುಹರ ನಿಜ ಸೀಲೋಮ್; ಆಸ್ಕಿಲ್ಮಿಂಥಿಸ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಿಥ್ಯ ಸೀಲೋಮ್; ಚಪ್ಪಟೆಹುಳುಗಳು ಸೀಲೋಮ್‌ರಹಿತ.

body.en: In some animals, like the earthworm, the body is divided into repeated segments externally and internally: this is metameric *segmentation*. The notochord is a rod-like structure formed from mesoderm on the dorsal side during embryonic development. Animals with a notochord are chordates; those without are non-chordates.
body.kn: ಎರೆಹುಳುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ದೇಹ ಒಳಗೂ ಹೊರಗೂ ಖಂಡಗಳಾಗಿ ವಿಭಜಿತ: ಮೆಟಾಮೆರಿಕ್ ಖಂಡೀಕರಣ. ನೋಟೋಕಾರ್ಡ್ ಭ್ರೂಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆನ್ನಿನ ಕಡೆ ಮಧ್ಯಸ್ತರದಿಂದ ರೂಪುಗೊಳ್ಳುವ ಕಡ್ಡಿಯಂತಹ ರಚನೆ.

problem.en: An animal is triploblastic, bilaterally symmetrical, and has a body cavity that is not lined by mesoderm. Name its phylum and give an example.

steps.en: Triploblastic and bilateral rules out sponges and coelenterates.
A body cavity not lined by mesoderm is a pseudocoelom.
Pseudocoelomates are Aschelminthes, for example Ascaris.

say.en:
Pause and solve this exam pattern question. Match the level of organisation with the phylum:
a. Cellular level b. Tissue level c. Organ level d. Organ-system level
i Platyhelminthes ii Porifera iii Coelenterata iv Annelida.
Sponges are at the cellular level, coelenterates at the tissue level, flatworms at the organ level and annelids at the organ-system level.

points.en: Levels: cellular (sponges), tissue (cnidarians), organ (flatworms), organ system (others).

narration.en: Recap. Levels: cellular (sponges), tissue (cnidarians), organ (flatworms), organ system (others). Coelenterates are diploblastic; flatworms onwards are triploblastic. Acoelomate flatworms, pseudocoelomate roundworms, coelomate others. The notochord separates chordates from non-chordates.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಮಟ್ಟಗಳು: ಕೋಶ, ಅಂಗಾಂಶ, ಅಂಗ, ಅಂಗವ್ಯೂಹ. ಸೀಲೆಂಟರೇಟ್‌ಗಳು ದ್ವಿಸ್ತರಿಗಳು; ಚಪ್ಪಟೆಹುಳುಗಳಿಂದ ಮುಂದೆ ತ್ರಿಸ್ತರಿಗಳು. ಚಪ್ಪಟೆಹುಳು ಸೀಲೋಮ್‌ರಹಿತ, ದುಂಡುಹುಳು ಮಿಥ್ಯ ಸೀಲೋಮ್, ಉಳಿದವು ನಿಜ ಸೀಲೋಮ್. ನೋಟೋಕಾರ್ಡ್ ಕಾರ್ಡೇಟ್ ಮತ್ತು ಅಕಾರ್ಡೇಟ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಬೇರ್ಪಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: Let us recall the key ideas. Levels: cellular sponges, tissue cnidarians, organ flatworms, organ system others.
